verdict.rationale: Salesforce explicitly points developers to its public APIs ([salesforce-docs-7]) and to apps that connect securely to Salesforce data ([salesforce-docs-13]). It also ships an official CLI that drives org data programmatically, such as `sf data query` ([salesforce-gh-3], [salesforce-probe-4]), and an official MCP server ([salesforce-probe-3]). The failed OpenAPI probe only checked the marketing domain, so it does not contradict the API's existence. Missing for 10: in-depth API reference documentation in the pack (endpoints, auth, rate limits), a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration of driving Sales Cloud via the API.
